changes.name: Postman（ブログ）
changes.diff_text:
+Finding three-way API drift with the AI Engineer
+Talia Kohan
+Find three-way API drift with Postman AI Engineer and the Context Graph. Compares your OpenAPI spec, collection requests, and live server responses.
+Read more →
-The prompts only the Postman AI Engineer can answer
-Talia Kohan
-The Postman AI Engineer prompts that trace an ID across your APIs, catch three-way drift, and auto-write a PR review from the graph.
-Read more →
changes.summary: Postman AI EngineerとContext Graphを活用し、OpenAPI仕様、コレクションリクエスト、実サーバー応答の3者間APIドリフトを検出する手法に関する記事が公開されました。
